method: Explicit allowlist projection with full frozen-comparator recomputation and independent raw token/tail verification
excluded_categories: Raw prompt and output arrays or model responses
Machine names, GPU UUIDs, addresses and allocation identifiers
Raw process logs, orchestration metadata and GPU snapshots
Container registry or internal service URLs
transforms: Local model location becomes public model identifier
Per-request timestamps independently rebased within each clock domain
Cache paths become rank plus checksum
Tail witness becomes anonymous array position
portable_path_policy: Exact harness /work mounts are generic reproduction conventions, not original host paths
runtime_policy: Exact recorded development-build versions retained; no claim those builds are publicly installable
